title: Strings
description: Satr yaratish, template literal, maxsus belgilar va satrlar bilan ishlash metodlari.

blocks.text: Satr (`string`) — belgilar ketma-ketligi. TypeScript'da satrni uch xil qo'shtirnoq bilan yozish mumkin:

items: Teskari qo'shtirnoq (backtick, klaviaturada `Ё` tugmasi) — bu **template literal**.

blocks.text: Birinchi ikkitasi o'rtasida farq yo'q — loyihada bittasini tanlab, izchil ishlating.

Backtick ichida `${ifoda}` yozilsa, ifoda hisoblanib, natijasi matnga qo'yiladi. Bu **interpolyatsiya** deyiladi va `+` bilan ulashdan ancha o'qishli. Shuningdek, template literal bir necha qatorga yoyilishi mumkin.
Satrni yaratgandan keyin uning ichidagi belgini o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi: `text[0] = "X"` hech narsa qilmaydi. Barcha satr metodlari **yangi satr qaytaradi**, asl satr o'zgarmaydi.
`text.length` — belgilar soni. `text[0]` yoki `text.at(0)` — birinchi belgi. `text.at(-1)` — oxirgi belgi (manfiy indeks oxiridan sanaydi).

examples.title: Template literal bilan interpolyatsiya
examples.code:
const name = "Dilnoza"
const age = 24
const city = "Buxoro"

// Eski usul — o'qish qiyin
const old = "Ism: " + name + ", yosh: " + age

// Template literal — aniq va toza
const modern = `Ism: ${name}, yosh: ${age}, shahar: ${city}`
const next = `Keyingi yili ${age + 1} yoshda bo'ladi`

console.log(old)
console.log(modern)
console.log(next)
examples.output:
Ism: Dilnoza, yosh: 24
Ism: Dilnoza, yosh: 24, shahar: Buxoro
Keyingi yili 25 yoshda bo'ladi

topics.title: String Methods
topics.summary: Qidirish, kesish, almashtirish, bo'lish va formatlash

blocks.text: Satrlar bilan ishlash uchun ko'plab tayyor metodlar mavjud. Esda tuting: **ularning hech biri asl satrni o'zgartirmaydi** — natija har doim yangi satr (yoki boshqa qiymat).

rows: Boshi va oxiridagi bo'shliqlarni olib tashlaydi

blocks.text: `slice(start, end)` — `start` dan `end` gacha (end kirmaydi) qismni qaytaradi. Manfiy indekslarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi: `slice(-3)` — oxirgi 3 belgi. `substring()` ham shunga o'xshash, lekin manfiy indeksni tushunmaydi — shuning uchun `slice` afzal.
Metodlarni zanjir qilib chaqirish mumkin: `input.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-")` — bu URL uchun "slug" yasashning klassik usuli.

function truncate(text: string, maxLength: number): string {
    if (text.length <= maxLength) return text
    return text.slice(0, maxLength - 3).trimEnd() + "..."
}

const article = "TypeScript JavaScript ustiga qurilgan tiplangan dasturlash tilidir"

console.log(truncate(article, 30))
console.log(truncate(article, 50))

examples.title: URL uchun slug yasash
examples.code:
function slugify(title: string): string {
    return title
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
        .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
        .replace(/-+/g, "-")
}

console.log(slugify("  Hello World!  "))
console.log(slugify("TypeScript 5.0 — What's New?"))
console.log(slugify("Multiple   Spaces   Here"))

examples.code:
const initials = (full: string) => full.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(w => w[0].toUpperCase() + ".").join("")
console.log(initials("abdulla qodiriy"), initials("Alisher Navoiy"))

examples.code:
const chunkStr = (s: string, n: number) => s.match(new RegExp(`.{1,${n}}`, "g")) ?? []
console.log(chunkStr("8600123412345678", 4).join(" "))

examples.title: HTML'dan xavfsizlash (escape)
examples.code:
const escapeHtml = (s: string) => s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'" })[c]!)
console.log(escapeHtml(`<script>alert("x")</script>`))
